env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# A two-target receive whose frozen index holds a checked make length inside
# a matched selector receiver: the freeze temp must keep the MulLen check the
# wrap absorbed, so an overflowing length panics in native and ejected builds
# and a valid length evaluates the operand once.

cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/constswitch_select_makelen.lgo a/main.lgo

cd a
logos run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/constswitch_select_makelen.out
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/constswitch_select_makelen.out
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
cd ../..

-- a/go.mod --
module example.com/cswselectmakelen

go 1.27
